idea: Agent-callable CSV preflight Apify Actor: validate structure (row width, quotes, empty/duplicate headers, encoding BOM) of a CSV at a URL or pasted text and return stable JSON errors
condition: Founder provides Apify configuration + 0600 credential (PUBLISH_ACTOR NOT_CONFIGURED). Until then only private-ready source can be prepared.

observed: humble-echidna/dataset-transform: 38 users in 30 days, pay-per-event (clean/dedupe/transform CSV/JSON)
evidence.interpretation: Small but real pay-per-event usage of generic file-utility Actors on Apify; budgets exist at cents-per-run scale. Store users are not revenue and the figures are listing data, untrusted.

competition: Transform/merge Actors exist; none in this 30-item search is described as a pre-import structure validator. Absence may mean low demand.
monetization_hypothesis: Pay-per-event e.g. USD 0.005 per file checked; must exceed platform compute cost (unmeasured).
cheapest_test: Private publish, run on the existing fixtures, then list publicly after independent APPROVE; measure ACTOR_STATS runs over 14 days; kill threshold: fewer than 3 external users in 14 days.
uncertainties: Whether agents/users search for validation vs transformation
relation_to_invoice: Reuses tested parser from products/invoice-preflight; avoids depending on Show HN account or Cloudflare.
